appReset.confirm:
This puts back: the activity bar you curated, collapsed sidebars, sidebar widths, your hand sorting, and named view instances with their state.

This stays: your saved workspaces, colour scheme, language, text size, permissions and installed plugins. Workspace layouts stay too, unless you include them below.
appReset.desc: Puts the arrangement back the way this app shipped it.
appReset.title: Reset app layout
appReset.includeWorkspaces: Reset every workspace layout as well
appReset.includeWorkspacesHint: Each workspace goes back to its baseline. Use this when a workspace no longer works as it should.

auth.requiredMessage: Sign in with an account that has permission to see this content.
auth.deniedMessage: Your account does not have access to this content. Ask your administrator for the permission it needs.

split.unavailable: This view can’t be shown in a split yet.
split.awaiting: Nothing open yet. Pick something to show here.

permission.blocked: This action was blocked because a permission it needs is turned off. Open Settings → Permissions to change it.

popout.unavailable: This view isn’t available in a separate window.

blocked.title: Pop-up blocked
blocked.message: Your browser blocked the new window. Click the button below to open it — or allow pop-ups for this site to skip this step next time.

retention.unsavedMessage: There are unsaved changes here. What should happen to them?
retention.saveFailed: Saving failed — your changes are kept and the surface stays open
retention.stillDirty: The surface still reports unsaved changes after saving — closing was cancelled
retention.vetoPendingMessage: This tab's plugin has not finished its close check yet. You can close the tab anyway.

route.unavailableMessage: This view does not exist in this application. The link may come from a different environment.

capabilityDesc.contributions: Register commands, views, menu items, icons and routes.
capabilityDesc.ui: Show dialogs, prompts, messages, menus and the settings surface.
capabilityDesc.host: Read the app version and update state.
capabilityDesc.navigation: Navigate the content area and open, pin or close tabs.
capabilityDesc.session: Read whether you are signed in and which roles you hold.
capabilityDesc.theme: Recolor the whole app by contributing design tokens (never overrides tenant branding).
capabilityDesc.automation: Run actions other plugins contributed, and list which ones it may run. It reaches only actions their authors opened, and only where you could have run them yourself.

settings.permissionsDesc: Turn a whole plugin on or off, or manage what each one is allowed to do. Changes take effect immediately; the distribution can never grant more than what is listed here.
settings.permissionsProvided: Provided by your organisation. These permissions were issued with the plugin and cannot be withdrawn here.
settings.permissionsRequired: Part of this application. It cannot be switched off here; what it is allowed to do can still be changed.
settings.pluginDisabled: This plugin is turned off. Turn it on to manage its permissions.

pluginLevel.trusted: Runs inside this application — what holds it back is what you granted it below, not the browser.
pluginLevel.embedded: Runs embedded — it keeps an origin of its own and is not held back from this application.
pluginLevel.isolated: Runs isolated — it cannot reach this application, its storage or your session.

settings.storeDesc: Install reviewed plugins from this product's store. A plugin only gets the permissions shown when you install it; you can revoke them or uninstall the plugin at any time.
settings.storeError: The plugin catalog could not be loaded.
settings.storeNoInstalled: Nothing installed yet — browse the catalog to get started.
settings.storeProvidedHint: Provided by your organisation — it cannot be turned off or removed here.
settings.storeSearch: Search plugins by name, author or description…
settings.storeSelectHint: Select a plugin on the left to see its details.
settings.storeUninstallConfirm: **{{name}}** will be removed and its contributions disappear immediately. Its settings are kept in case you install it again later.
settings.title: Settings

textSize.label: Text size
textSize.desc: Scale the whole interface up or down.

theme.label: Theme
theme.desc: Light, dark, or follow the system.

update.checkUnavailable: Can't check for updates — please reload the page
update.failed: Update couldn't be installed — reload to retry
update.broken: This app's offline cache is broken. Repairing rebuilds it from scratch.

viewInstance.deleteConfirm: Delete the saved view “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.

workspace.title: Workspaces
workspace.resetConfirm: Reset this workspace? Its layout returns to the saved baseline; your saved workspaces are kept.
workspace.saveBaselineHint: Makes the current arrangement this workspace’s new baseline.
workspace.applyConfirm: Make the current arrangement this workspace’s new baseline? The previously saved one is replaced.
workspace.resetHint: Discards this workspace’s changes and returns to its saved baseline.
workspace.saveAsHint: Saves the current arrangement as a new workspace and switches to it.
workspace.unusableTitle: This workspace has no content left
workspace.unusableBody: Its saved layout no longer holds the content this workspace declares, so there is nothing here to show. Resetting puts back the layout it was declared with. Your other workspaces are untouched.

railLabels.desc: Show each entry’s name under its icon.
